opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: New Projects and Commissions up to £20,000; Acquisitions and Collections up to £20,000; Conferences, Lectures and Publications up to £5,000; Long-Term Research up to £20,000; Research and Travel up to £2,500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non-profit organisations (established and operating non-profit for at least 12 months) for exhibitions, catalogues, commissions, conferences, research, publications and collections development. Individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators can apply under the Research and Travel category. Not open to individuals developing their own artistic practice.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, and research expanding appreciation of sculpture. Categories: New Projects and Commissions, Acquisitions and Collections, Conferences/Lectures/Publications, Long-Term Research, and Research and Travel. Applications considered four times per year.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Expenses allocation for travel and subsistence: UK up to £600, Europe up to £700, Rest of world up to £1,000; plus accommodation in Leeds or Hertfordshire for the duration of the fellowship

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics, curators, artists and researchers working on historic and contemporary sculpture. Artist Research Fellowships support artists developing their practice through research. Senior Fellowships for established scholars (six weeks).
opportunities.summary: Fellowships enabling researchers to spend a month using the Henry Moore Institute facilities in Leeds or Henry Moore Studios & Gardens in Hertfordshire, including accommodation, travel and subsistence expenses. Applications for 2026/27 are closed; next round opens in spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Dissertation Prize

amount.raw: £250 cash prize for BA dissertation and £250 for MA dissertation; plus Henry Moore Institute publications to the value of £50

opportunities.eligibility_summary: BA and MA students of all disciplines at UK universities, for a dissertation submitted within the past academic year relating directly to sculpture. Dissertation must not have been previously published.
opportunities.summary: Two annual prizes for outstanding extended writing on contemporary, modern or historical sculpture, open to BA and MA students. Submissions for the 2026 prize will open in autumn.
